core_abi_rule: all controller outputs copied and verified byte-identical except explicitly observed src/core/decode_graph.cpp; no Core header/layout difference
provider_rule: one new full worker Core; raw Ops archive files; no parent controller/old Core/old Models/old cache extraction

source_scope.model: Qwen3.5 including MoE when its actual geometry matches
source_scope.profile: off with real process route table clear

admission_order: public pure options before DeviceContext initialization
actual LoadPlan geometry and environment policy before weight materialization
frozen sequence plan and fresh payload inventory before native Program resident allocation
retire_error: sticky exception, unavailable worker, diagnostic; precondition rejection does not imply Core disabled
startup_secondary_error: typed SegmentedWorkerStartupFailure retains primary and retirement exception_ptr
same_graph_rule: actual successful launch of same exec address plus instance generation and update revision, count strictly increases
fixture_causal_criterion: all finite FP32 score bits exactly equal to sequential ordinary control
fixture_generation_criterion: same exact four greedy token IDs, zero reused prefix, true same-live-unrevised-exec launch witness
